I reviewed pit's change, but I couldn't post the fix requests on cv/pit#372: this run's token can't comment on `cv/pit` (`Resource not accessible by integration`). The comment is below for you to paste, or you can give pi-action's app write access to issues on `cv/pit`.

**What pit did:** it committed `c8e70c7b` ("show typescript calls in host logs with a present field") and the version bump `a693926a` to 0.36.4 straight to `main`, with no PR. CI passes on Node 22, 24 and 26. The run you linked was still going when I checked, and the `v0.36.4` tag and release didn't exist yet.

**How I checked it:** I installed pit from `a693926a`, loaded its `typescript` tool, passed it to pi-action's `Activity.useTools()` from #82, and fed it typical calls and edge cases. It matches the contract, and the normal paths render well:

```text
🔧 Read the notes
▸   ↳ ✓ 0.1s · workspace.read · git.status
async ({ workspace: { read }, git: { status } }) => read("a.txt")
──
file: a.txt
content:
one
two
```

Errors show as `↳ ✗ failed 0.1s · Error: boom`, with the full error in the details.

**Problems found:**
1. **Empty title.** A call with no label and blank code gets the title `""`. pi-action warns and falls back to the generic line.
2. **`saved undefined`.** A `saveOnly` call whose `details.value` has no `savedFunction` shows `saved undefined`.
3. **Crash on missing `details`.** `result()` throws when `details` isn't an object, at `"value" in details`. pit's own results always have `details` (question results too), so this only hardens the code; pi-action already falls back.
4. **Optional:** a question result could show `asked: <title>` instead of the list of functions.
5. **Broken link until #82 merges.** pit's `docs/durable.md` links to the pi-action docs section that #82 adds. #82 is mergeable and its checks pass.

I didn't commit anything here; the check used a scratch directory in `/tmp`.

**Comment to paste on cv/pit#372:**

````markdown
@pi Review of c8e70c7b (`present` on the `typescript` tool), from pi-action's side. I checked it end to end: pit at a693926a, loaded with jiti, its tool passed to pi-action's `Activity.useTools()` from cv/pi-action#82. The main paths look right:

```text
🔧 Read the notes
▸   ↳ ✓ 0.1s · workspace.read · git.status
async ({ workspace: { read }, git: { status } }) => read("a.txt")
──
file: a.txt
content:
one
two
```

Errors show `↳ ✗ failed 0.1s · Error: boom` with the full error in the details. Please fix these in a patch release:

1. **`call()` can return an empty title.** For a program with no label and blank code (`{ code: "   " }`), `title` is `""`. The contract requires a title that isn't empty, so pi-action warns `present.call() returned no title` and falls back. Use a fallback title, such as `functionId` or `typescript`.
2. **`saveOnly` summary shows `saved undefined`.** This happens when `details.value` has no string `savedFunction`, for example after a failed save that isn't `isError`, or when the shape of the details changes. Check that it's a string. If it isn't, use the function name from the code or `functionId`, or leave the summary out.
3. **`result()` throws when `details` isn't an object.** `"value" in details` throws a `TypeError` (`Cannot use 'in' operator ... in undefined`). pit's own results always have details, but pi-durable writes some results itself, and the host passes whatever is stored. Check `isRecord(result.details)`, and use `resultText(result)` if it isn't one. The same applies to the casts in `callArguments` when `code` isn't a string.
4. **Optional:** for a question result (`details.question`), the summary could be `asked: <title>` instead of the list of injected functions. That tells someone reading the log why the turn ended.

Please add a test for each case in `test/durable/present.test.ts`.

Separately: the link to [Show tool calls in the workflow log](https://github.com/cv/pi-action/blob/main/docs/extensions.md#show-tool-calls-in-the-workflow-log) in `docs/durable.md` only resolves once cv/pi-action#82 is merged.
````

**Next in pi-action, after #82 merges and pit ships a tagged release with these fixes:**
- Pin the new pit version in `.github/workflows/pi-assistant.yml` and the docs examples.
- Remove the `// @pit:` parsing from `src/activity.ts`.
